statement: Daily download counts from the npm download-counts API (api.npmjs.org/downloads/range): the context days 2025-09-01 to 2026-06-02 retrieved 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15 UTC, the target days 2026-06-03 to 2026-08-31 retrieved 2026-10-15 UTC. Package names and creation timestamps are from the npm public registry (registry.npmjs.org, replicate.npmjs.com) as served at acquisition; a name may since have been removed. A download is a tarball request as npm counts it, mirrors, build servers and bots included. npm, Inc. states no licence for the counts, and its Open-Source Terms of 2022-03-10 contain no restriction on their redistribution. The context pull reached npm's rate limit 2,708 times and honoured it. The download API reports 0 for every series on 2026-07-12 and 2026-08-14 and for aggregate-error on 2026-06-25; the counts are as served (PROTOCOL.md, dated addition 6).
